fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Hover-mechanized infantry ride hovercraft that can cover ground faster than any tracked or wheeled formation in the DCMS inventory. District commanders prize these platoons for rapid redeployment between garrison posts, and during the Jihad, hover-mechanized troops proved their worth in the kind of hit-and-run resistance operations that the Dictum Honorium demanded of citizens on occupied worlds. Their support troops carry man-portable flamers that spray burning chemicals across several hundred square meters. Devastating against infantry in the open and effective at clearing structures, though the short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
